assistantSettings.title: Agent Settings
assistantSettings.description: Configure advanced capabilities for generic Agent. Idea assistant and workflow Agent share these parameters and modes.

temperature.label: Sampling temperature (temperature)
temperature.help1: Controls randomness of output. Higher = more creative/divergent; lower = more stable/conservative.

maxTokens.label: Max output tokens
maxTokens.help1: Controls max length of one response. Larger values allow longer output but increase latency and cost.

timeout.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.help1: Limits max waiting time per call to avoid hanging requests.

reactMode.label: React mode
reactMode.help1: Model emits tool-call commands in text protocol (<Action>{...}</Action>).
reactMode.help2: System parses then executes tools; useful for models without function-calling support.

contextSummary.label: Context summary
contextSummary.help1: Enable summary compression for long context in assistant turns.
contextSummary.help2: Reduce token cost and keep continuity.

contextThreshold.label: Summary threshold
contextThreshold.help1: Threshold controls when context is summarized.
